source: User-provided SoundScript V15 — Documentation Reliability & Developer Experience specification

requirements.title: Existing modern documentation hub
requirements.requirement:
`docs/documentation.md` already provides a goal-oriented documentation hub.

It currently includes paths such as:

```text
Quick start
Common tasks
.NET API
V14 programmable media
NuGet
application samples
language reference
CLI
transcription
architecture
```

Preserve its useful intent-oriented structure and evolve it into the canonical V15 documentation index.

requirements.title: Existing legacy hub
requirements.requirement:
`docs/SoundScript.md` currently behaves as an older documentation index and contains substantial V11/V10/V9/etc. structure.

It currently describes itself as:

```text
the documentation hub for V11
```

This is stale as the primary documentation hub.

Do not delete it without considering inbound links.

requirements.title: Documentation viewer currently defaults to legacy hub
requirements.requirement:
`docs/doc.html` currently defines:

```javascript
var DEFAULT_PAGE = 'SoundScript.md';
```

and primary Docs navigation also points at:

```text
/doc.html?p=SoundScript.md
```

V15 must resolve this intentionally.

requirements.title: Existing docs rendering style
requirements.requirement:
`docs/doc.html` already has:

```text
dark developer-oriented theme
monospace code treatment
inline code styling
fenced code styling
responsive layout
focus-visible accessibility
reduced-motion support
Markdown rendering through marked
```

Preserve this design language.

requirements.title: Bump development version
requirements.requirement:
Update canonical development identity in `Directory.Build.props`:

```xml
<Version>15.0.0</Version>
<SoundScriptVersionLabel>V15</SoundScriptVersionLabel>
<SoundScriptCodename>Documentation Reliability & Developer Experience</SoundScriptCodename>
```

Preserve the existing property structure.

requirements.title: Development and public states differ
requirements.requirement:
During implementation this must be valid:

```text
developmentVersion = 15.0.0
publicVersion      = 14.0.0
```

requirements.title: No implicit publication
requirements.requirement: Changing development version must never cause user-facing documentation to advertise V15 before public release state explicitly changes.

requirements.title: Release notes
requirements.requirement:
Add a V15 section to `RELEASE_NOTES.md`.

Describe the actual V15 work:

```text
documentation reliability
structured documentation hub
release-state management
generated current-state blocks
developer documentation UX
CI documentation drift protection
```

Do not describe V15 as published.

requirements.title: One authority per fact
requirements.requirement:
Every generated or validated current-state fact must have exactly one documented authoritative source.

Do not hide release-specific constants in `update-docs.ps1`.

requirements.title: Required ownership map
requirements.requirement:
Use this model unless repository inspection identifies a stronger existing source:

| Fact                        | Authoritative source                                     |
| --------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------- |
| Development version         | `Directory.Build.props`                                  |
| V label                     | `Directory.Build.props`                                  |
| Codename                    | `Directory.Build.props`                                  |
| Public version              | `docs/release-state.json`                                |
| Library publication state   | `docs/release-state.json`                                |
| CLI NuGet publication state | `docs/release-state.json`                                |
| CLI GitHub-release state    | `docs/release-state.json`                                |
| Library package ID          | `src/SoundScript/SoundScript.csproj`                     |
| CLI package ID              | `src/SoundScript.Cli/SoundScript.Cli.csproj`             |
| CLI command name            | `src/SoundScript.Cli/SoundScript.Cli.csproj`             |
| Target framework            | canonical project configuration                          |
| CLI public commands         | actual CLI registration/help surface                     |
| CLI exit codes              | canonical runtime/source definition                      |
| Release history             | `RELEASE_NOTES.md`                                       |
| Docs classification         | `docs/docs-manifest.json`                                |
| Site/public base URL        | canonical existing repository configuration if available |

requirements.title: No unnecessary duplication
requirements.requirement: Do not duplicate package IDs, CLI command name, target framework, repository identity, or other canonical project metadata into release-state JSON when they can be read reliably from project configuration.

requirements.title: Stable URL templates allowed
Add schema-validated release state
Flags apply specifically to publicVersion
requirements.requirement:
Publication flags mean:

```text
Is this specific publicVersion available through this channel?
```

not:

```text
Has any historical SoundScript version ever been published here?
```

requirements.title: State invariants
requirements.requirement:
Validate before documentation generation:

```text
supported schemaVersion
required fields
correct types
valid semantic version
publicVersion <= developmentVersion
library NuGet command only when library.nugetPublished=true
CLI NuGet command only when cli.nugetPublished=true
GitHub Release link only when cli.githubReleasePublished=true
```

Unknown schema versions fail.
`RELEASE_NOTES.md` remains manually authored release history.
Do not derive install commands, publication flags, package IDs, target frameworks, or distribution status by parsing release-note prose.
Release notes may be used for consistency validation and by the already-existing homepage release-history generator.

Do not unnecessarily rewrite `update-homepage-release.ps1`.

Reuse its safe design patterns where useful.

requirements.title: Deterministic scope
requirements.requirement:
Audit:

```text
root *.md
docs/**/*.md
docs/**/*.html
docs documentation-state JSON
packaging/**/*.md
sample README files
tutorial README files
website current-navigation/current-content files
project package metadata containing public guidance
script usage/help text
workflow files containing release/install commands
```

requirements.title: Exclusions
requirements.requirement:
Exclude:

```text
artifacts/
bin/
obj/
generated build output
vendored dependencies
binary content
temporary files
experiments/SoundScript.Labs/
```

Create:

```text
docs/v15-documentation-audit.md
```

before large structural documentation edits.

Record:

```text
audit scope
fact ownership
living docs
historical docs
excluded files
unclassified files
stale current guidance
contradictions
duplicate instructions
duplicate hubs/indexes
generated-block candidates
reviewed files needing no change
historical wording intentionally preserved
unresolved issues
```

Explicitly inspect at minimum:

```text
README.md
docs/documentation.md
docs/SoundScript.md
docs/doc.html
docs/index.html
packaging/README.md
docs/quick-start.md
docs/nuget.md
docs/dotnet-api.md
docs/cli.md
docs/common-tasks.md
docs/programmatic-media-runtime.md
docs/tutorials/programmable-media.md
docs/releasing.md
```

requirements.title: Living docs
requirements.requirement: Living documentation describes what users/developers can do now.

requirements.title: Historical docs
requirements.requirement:
Historical documents preserve release-specific engineering evidence.

Examples:

```text
v14-acceptance-report.md
v13-reliability-hardening.md
release-readiness reports
historical implementation reports
version-specific engineering evidence
```

requirements.title: Preserve historical truth
requirements.requirement:
Do not rewrite historically accurate:

```text
old versions
candidate terminology
historical install commands
historical test counts
historical package state
historical compatibility baselines
```
Only correct historical content for a genuine factual mistake, explicit erratum, or broken local link that can be corrected without changing historical meaning.

Create:

```text
docs/docs-manifest.json
```

Preferred concept:

```json
{
  "schemaVersion": 1,
  "livingDocuments": [],
  "historicalDocuments": [],
  "historicalPatterns": [],
  "generatedOnly": [],
  "excluded": {},
  "generatedBlocks": {}
}
```

requirements.title: Completeness
requirements.requirement:
Every in-scope documentation file must be:

```text
living
historical
generated-only
or explicitly excluded with a reason
```

Unclassified files fail validation.

requirements.title: Conflicts
requirements.requirement:
A file cannot simultaneously be living and historical.

Conflicts fail.

requirements.title: Explicit precedence
requirements.requirement: Explicit file declarations take precedence over patterns, but contradictory classification must still require an explicit justified override rather than silently resolving.

requirements.title: Generated-block mapping
requirements.requirement:
Map allowed generated blocks per file.

Example:

```json
"generatedBlocks": {
  "README.md": [
    "LIBRARY_INSTALL",
    "CLI_DISTRIBUTION"
  ],
  "docs/quick-start.md": [
    "LIBRARY_INSTALL",
    "CLI_DISTRIBUTION"
  ]
}
```

requirements.title: One canonical documentation index
requirements.requirement:
Establish:

```text
docs/documentation.md
```

as the canonical structured documentation hub.

Do not create another competing hub.

requirements.title: Structured by developer intent
requirements.requirement:
The canonical hub should be organized approximately as:

```text
Start Here
  Quick Start
  Playground
  User Guide

Build with .NET
  NuGet
  .NET API
  Application Samples
  Programmable Media Runtime

Use the CLI
  Installation / Distribution
  CLI Reference
  Automation / CI
  Common CLI Tasks

Author Audio & Music
  Language Reference
  Wave Grammar
  SoundCSS
  Vocal
  Composition / Prosody
  Examples

Programmable Media
  Temporal Visuals
  Programmable Media Tutorial
  Audio/Visual Examples
  WebM / Synchronization

Transcription
  Main Transcription Guide
  Monophonic baseline
  Melody extraction
  Polyphonic/Piano
  Mixed roles
  Percussion

Automation & Testing
  Deterministic fixtures
  DevOps sonification
  CI workflows
  NuGet end-to-end examples

Architecture & Internals
  Architecture
  Pipeline
  Runtime contracts
  Package structure

Reference
  Complete language reference
  CLI reference
  supported platforms
  limitations/dependencies

Historical Engineering Evidence
  V14 acceptance
  V13 hardening
  older release-specific reports
```

Use existing documents whenever possible.

Do not create duplicate guides merely to fill categories.

requirements.title: Goal-first descriptions
requirements.requirement:
Each hub entry should answer:

```text
Why would a developer open this?
```

rather than simply repeat the filename.

requirements.title: Current vs historical separation
requirements.requirement:
Historical engineering reports must have their own clearly identified section.

Do not mix historical evidence into the normal getting-started path.

requirements.title: Keep hub concise
requirements.requirement: The canonical hub is an index/navigation surface, not another complete user guide.

requirements.title: Do not retain competing V11 hub
requirements.requirement: `docs/SoundScript.md` must no longer act as the primary full documentation index.

requirements.title: Preserve inbound compatibility
requirements.requirement:
Do not break old URLs unnecessarily.

Preferred solution:

Convert `docs/SoundScript.md` into a concise compatibility landing page such as:

```text

requirements.title: Viewer default
requirements.requirement:
Change `docs/doc.html` default page from:

```javascript
SoundScript.md
```

to:

```javascript
documentation.md
```

provided validation confirms no architectural issue.

requirements.title: Site Docs navigation
requirements.requirement:
Current Docs navigation should point to the canonical documentation hub.

Update links such as:

```text
/doc.html?p=SoundScript.md
```

to:

```text
/doc.html?p=documentation.md
```

where they represent current Docs navigation.

Do not rewrite legitimate historical links.

requirements.title: Structured data/help links
requirements.requirement:
Audit:

```text
softwareHelp
canonical docs URLs
structured-data documentation URLs
footer Docs links
sitemap entries if applicable
```

and point current documentation entry surfaces toward the canonical hub.

Generate only volatile repeated current facts.

Candidate block IDs:

```text
LIBRARY_INSTALL
CLI_DISTRIBUTION
CURRENT_PUBLIC_RELEASE
CURRENT_DEVELOPMENT_VERSION
DOTNET_REQUIREMENT
CURRENT_PACKAGE_LINKS
SUPPORTED_PLATFORMS
```
Do not generate complete guides/tutorials/architecture reports.

Use markers:

```markdown
<!-- GENERATED:LIBRARY_INSTALL_START -->
...
<!-- GENERATED:LIBRARY_INSTALL_END -->
```

Reject:

```text
undeclared markers
duplicate START
duplicate END
mismatched identifiers
nested generated blocks
END-before-START
generated current-state blocks in prohibited historical docs
```
Never globally replace old version numbers.

Create:

```text
scripts/update-docs.ps1
```

requirements.title: Update mode
requirements.requirement:
```powershell
./scripts/update-docs.ps1
```

must:

```text
validate state
validate manifest
validate markers
render expected content in memory
update only approved generated block bodies
preserve surrounding prose
```

requirements.title: Check mode
requirements.requirement:
```powershell
./scripts/update-docs.ps1 -Check
```

must:

```text
modify no tracked documentation
detect block drift
detect state errors
detect manifest errors
detect marker errors
detect stale current-state claims
detect distribution contradictions
return non-zero on violations
```

requirements.title: Internal validation categories
requirements.requirement:
Structure implementation so tests can exercise:

```text
release state
manifest
classification
markers
rendering
drift
stale current statements
CLI docs
exit codes
links
```

independently.

requirements.title: Idempotency
requirements.requirement: Two consecutive updates with unchanged input must produce no second diff.

An old version mention is not automatically stale.

Reject it only when presented as the current/recommended:

```text
install version
package version
release identity
download
public distribution
```

Similarly, `candidate` is allowed in genuine historical/comparison context.

Reject it when living documentation incorrectly calls an already-public current artifact a candidate.

Reject contradictions such as:

```text
publicVersion=14.0.0
Quick Start says install 13.0.0
```

or:

```text
CLI nugetPublished=false
README advertises dotnet tool install from NuGet.org
```

Recognize that global-tool packaging already exists.

Do not reimplement it.

While:

```json
"nugetPublished": false
```

living docs must not advertise:

```bash
dotnet tool install --global SoundScript.Cli
```

as a NuGet.org install path.

When CLI NuGet is unpublished, current docs should:

```text
state that fact
show supported GitHub release distribution if published
avoid local package smoke-test instructions as primary public onboarding
```

Future state:

```json
"nugetPublished": true
```

must automatically support generation of:

```bash
dotnet tool install --global SoundScript.Cli --version <publicVersion>
```

requirements.title: Preserve theme
requirements.requirement:
Enhance `docs/doc.html` within the existing design tokens and visual language.

Do not introduce an unrelated third-party-looking code theme.

requirements.title: Code-block shell
requirements.requirement:
Every fenced rendered code block should be presented using a consistent developer code container:

```text
┌─────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ C#                              [Copy] │
├─────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ var media = ...                        │
└─────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

Do not add excessive decorative chrome.

requirements.title: Copy button
requirements.requirement:
Add an accessible Copy control to rendered fenced code blocks.

Requirements:

```text
copies exact source text
does not copy language label
does not copy UI chrome
does not copy visual prompt decoration
temporarily indicates success
returns to Copy state
works independently for multiple blocks
```

requirements.title: Language labels
requirements.requirement:
Map Markdown language identifiers into clear labels.

At minimum:

```text
csharp      → C#
cs          → C#
soundscript → SoundScript
bash        → Bash
sh          → Shell
powershell  → PowerShell
pwsh        → PowerShell
cmd         → Command Prompt
json        → JSON
xml         → XML
javascript  → JavaScript
js          → JavaScript
html        → HTML
css         → CSS
text        → Text
```

Unknown languages may use a safely escaped normalized label or no label.

requirements.title: Terminal style
requirements.requirement:
Command fences:

```text
bash
sh
shell
powershell
pwsh
cmd
```

should receive a terminal-oriented presentation.

Terminal style may use:

```text
Terminal
PowerShell
Command Prompt
```

headers.

Do not modify underlying command content.

requirements.title: Prompt decoration
requirements.requirement:
If `$`, `PS>`, or `>` prompt decoration is displayed, it must be presentation-only.

Example:

```text
$ dotnet add package SoundScript
```

Copy result must remain:

```text
dotnet add package SoundScript
```

unless the literal prompt is actually present in Markdown source.

requirements.title: Output blocks
requirements.requirement:
Provide a clear style for command output.

Prefer an explicit documented fence convention such as:

````markdown
```console-output
Build succeeded.
0 Warning(s)
0 Error(s)
````

````

or a similarly unambiguous identifier.

Output blocks should not visually imply that the text should be executed.

requirements.title: Copy behavior for output
requirements.requirement:
Determine intentionally whether output blocks receive Copy.

Recommended:

```text
allow Copy for substantial output because developers often need logs,
but style them clearly as Output rather than Terminal.
````

Document the chosen rule.

requirements.title: Inline code
requirements.requirement:
Retain existing lightweight inline-code styling.

Do not add copy controls to inline identifiers.

requirements.title: Progressive enhancement
requirements.requirement:
Implement syntax highlighting only if it can be done cleanly, securely, and without a disproportionate dependency.

Priority order:

```text
1. code container
2. Copy
3. language labels
4. terminal/output differentiation
5. syntax highlighting
```

Do not hold the whole V15 documentation work hostage to advanced highlighting.

requirements.title: Target languages
requirements.requirement:
If highlighting is added, prioritize:

```text
SoundScript
C#
Bash/Shell
PowerShell
JSON
XML
JavaScript
HTML
CSS
```

requirements.title: SoundScript
requirements.requirement:
Where practical, first-class SoundScript highlighting may distinguish:

```text
comments
keywords/directives
notes
durations
strings
numbers
structural punctuation
```

Do not create or redefine grammar solely for highlighting.

requirements.title: Security
requirements.requirement:
Never render untrusted code contents as executable HTML.

Code text must remain escaped/safe.
Copy controls must be keyboard reachable.

Provide accessible names such as:

```text
Copy C# code
Copy Bash command
Copy SoundScript code
```

when practical.
Copy success state must not depend only on color.
Respect existing `prefers-reduced-motion`.
Focus-visible behavior must remain clear.
Long commands/code must horizontally scroll rather than overflow the page.
Copy buttons and labels must remain visible/usable on narrow displays.
Do not force code wrapping if doing so makes commands misleading.

Prefer:

```javascript
navigator.clipboard.writeText(...)
```

when safely available.
Provide a reasonable fallback where practical.
Clipboard failure must not alter/destroy code contents.
Do not request unnecessary browser permissions.

Audit living documentation for generic code fences.

Where the language/shell is known, use the correct fence identifier.

Example:

Prefer:

````markdown
```bash
dotnet build
````

````

over:

```markdown
````

dotnet build

```
```
Do not cosmetically rewrite historical engineering evidence merely to normalize fence labels.

Determine public CLI command authority in this order:

```text
1. actual command registration
2. deterministic local --help
3. central command definition
4. explicit documented allowlist only as last resort
```

Record selected authority in the audit.

Validate public command coverage.

At minimum inspect:

```text
validate
inspect
run
compose
prosody
render
wave
video
vocal
transcribe
```

plus any other current public commands discovered.

Distinguish where relevant:

```text
public
alias
experimental
hidden
internal
```
Locate canonical runtime/source authority for CLI exit codes.
Validate current documentation against it.

Do not change runtime exit values just to match documentation.

Correct docs if docs are stale.

requirements.title: Deterministic checks
requirements.requirement:
Validate where practical:

```text
relative Markdown target exists
docs target exists
heading fragment exists
repository file path exists
generated NuGet URL has correct ID/version
generated release URL has correct version
canonical docs navigation points to documentation.md
```

requirements.title: Network checks separate
requirements.requirement:
Transient external-site availability must not make required local CI flaky.

External availability may be:

```text
optional
scheduled
manual
```

unless already reliably handled by existing CI.

Audit current hardcoded release values in:

```text
docs/doc.html structured data
docs/index.html structured data
softwareVersion
softwareHelp
canonical documentation URL
```

Where current release/version facts are repeated, integrate them with the documentation state architecture where practical.

Do not blindly inject build-time state into static HTML if it makes publishing unsafe.

Use the simplest deterministic mechanism consistent with the rest of the documentation generator.

Do not change branding/SEO positioning unnecessarily.

Correct stale facts only.

Preserve:

```text
color palette
typography
logo
major layout
card language
code aesthetic
navigation style
developer-oriented tone
```

Keep the developer journey approximately:

```text
What is SoundScript?
        ↓
Try Playground
        ↓
Install / integrate
        ↓
NuGet / CLI
        ↓
Examples / tutorials
        ↓
Architecture
        ↓
Reference
```

No major navigation restructuring unless the audit identifies a real usability problem.

The canonical documentation hub restructuring is explicitly approved because two competing hubs currently exist.

Add:

```powershell
./scripts/update-docs.ps1 -Check
```

to the appropriate existing CI workflow.
Do not create a conflicting parallel documentation CI pipeline if an appropriate existing workflow can host the check.

Final report must identify:

```text
workflow
job
step
command
```

Failures should include:

```text
file
validation category
block/check ID
actual condition
expected condition
corrective action
```

Example:

```text
docs/quick-start.md
[STALE_CURRENT_INSTALL]
Recommended package is 13.0.0.
Public package is 14.0.0.
Run ./scripts/update-docs.ps1
```

Exit 0:

```text
update succeeded
or
check found no violations
```

Non-zero:

```text
invalid state
manifest error
marker error
drift
stale current documentation
CLI docs mismatch
deterministic link failure
documentation-policy violation
```

Generation must not depend on:

```text
clock
locale
user name
machine path
dictionary iteration randomness
network result
```
Preserve existing per-file line endings and encoding where practical.
Do not rewrite unrelated bytes outside approved generated sections.
No runtime behavior changes.
No public API changes.
No DSL grammar changes.
No runtime dependency upgrades.
`experiments/SoundScript.Labs/` untouched.
No publication/deployment.
No unrelated formatting changes to production source.
Test valid release state.
Test unsupported schema version.
Test invalid version.
Test public version newer than development version.
Test publication-channel contradictions.
Unclassified documentation fails.
Missing declared file fails.
Living/historical conflict fails.
Invalid exclusion fails.

Test:

```text
missing START
missing END
duplicate START
duplicate END
mismatched identifiers
nested block
out-of-order markers
undeclared marker
```
Test idempotency.
Test `-Check` does not mutate fixture bytes.
Test deliberate drift is detected.
Test development 15.0.0 + public 14.0.0 keeps 14.0.0 install command.
Test future CLI NuGet publication generates global-tool command correctly.
Historical candidate wording must remain valid.
Historical old version numbers must not be rewritten.
Current-state validation must not incorrectly treat historical evidence as stale.
Verify `documentation.md` is the canonical current hub.
Verify `doc.html` default loads the canonical hub.
Verify current Docs navigation resolves to canonical hub.
Verify `SoundScript.md` remains a valid compatibility destination and links to canonical hub.
Verify canonical hub links resolve deterministically.
Verify language label appears for known fenced languages.
Verify Copy copies exact Markdown code content.

Verify code containing:

< > & " ' script img onclick
```

remains text and cannot inject HTML/script.

Verify Copy success state.
Verify failure handling does not corrupt code.
Verify terminal/output/source blocks receive appropriate classes/labels.
Verify no obvious narrow-screen overflow regression.
Run existing homepage release-history tests.
Run relevant documentation/Playground Node tests.
Run relevant .NET regression tests.

Run:

```text
git diff --check
```
Inspect production/runtime diff and confirm documentation-focused scope.

Create an appropriate V15 acceptance/report artifact documenting implementation and validation.

Choose a clear path consistent with existing repository conventions, for example:

```text
docs/v15-documentation-reliability-report.md
```

The final requirement matrix must include **every requirement ID from this specification**.

Do not provide only representative entries.

Columns:

| Requirement | Evidence | Validation/inspection | Status | Notes |
| ----------- | -------- | --------------------- | ------ | ----- |

Statuses:

```text
PASS
FAIL
N/A — explicit reason required
```

Generate or programmatically validate the requirement-ID inventory so IDs are not accidentally omitted from the final matrix.
